messages.subject: Slow upload speed stalls app deployment
parts:
While testing the alpha version of shinyapps.io, i successfully deployed the test demo app. Then i tried to deploy an app - MineralSpec - that include some data, about 20 Mb. The deployment timed out, probabaly due to slow upload speed at your server. Can you please offer advice towards solution.

The full text output when i call deployApp()

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...Timing stopped at: 0.96 0.75 305.61 
Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : 
  SSL_write() returned SYSCALL, errno = 10053
Calls: <Anonymous> ... system.time -> <Anonymous> -> .Call -> <Anonymous> -> fun
Execution halted

Thanks

Leo Omolewa
